items.markdown:
A formal 60-day tourist visa for Thailand requires a passport with 6 months validity, a digital application via the [Thai E-Visa Official Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) , and proof of funds and travel . Note that entry regulations are shifting away from blanket 60-day visa-free arrivals for many nationalities back to shorter 30-day limits, making an applied tourist visa necessary for longer stays.[](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) [[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xbNwBMAWx-0&t=168)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/QsIyfqk1_xw)[[4]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78q3qjqnn5o)

Application Requirements

- **Passport:** Valid for at least 6 months past your arrival date with a recent photo.
- **Travel Proof:** Confirmed round-trip flight tickets showing exit within 60 days.
- **Where to Stay:** Hotel bookings, rental agreements, or a host letter.
- **Money:** Bank statements proving enough funds for your trip.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xbNwBMAWx-0&t=168) 

Extensions and Rules

- **Stay Length:** Lasts up to 60 days from the day you arrive.
- **Extension:** Can be extended for 30 more days at a local Thai Immigration Bureau office for a fee of 1,900 baht.
- **Penalty:** Overstaying costs 500 baht for each extra day.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)[[2]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa-types)[[3]](https://th.usembassy.gov/thai-visas-for-americans/)
